title: renmods
text: ENMODS stores date/times character/text fields timezone indicated +/- offset (e.g., ‘-08:00’). However, R values column must use timezone. Therefore renmods converts times UTC-7:00 (called Etc/GMT+7, note + correct; see Wikipedia page timezones). may always ideal depending region ’re working , original timezone Observed_Date_Time stored new field ren_tz reference. can convert timezone using lubridate::with_tz() function. can see ’re UTC -7 looking first couple values. want UTC -6:00 can convert lubridate’s with_tz() function. converts first 5 observations, just illustration. want convert entire data frame Mountain time (including DST depending time year), use America/Edmonton timezone. wanted convert time columns , use across() function dplyr. First ’ll get whole data set time columns ? can use tidyselector contains() across apply function across series columns. Finally, can also prevent date/time conversion leave fields character.

title: Connect to ENMODS data via DuckDB — renmods_connect
text: Creates DuckDB connection cached ENMODS data. database table can filtered using dplyr collecting data frame collect(). Using dates (date range) types (data types) prefilters data specific date range specific data file. supplied, dates takes precedence. data files required connected fewer data sources connected smaller dataset, quicker collect() function run.

title: Connect to ENMODS data via DuckDB — renmods_connect
code: renmods_connect(dates = NULL, types = "all", convert_times = TRUE)

title: Connect to ENMODS data via DuckDB — renmods_connect
text: dates Character Date vector length 2. Start end dates filtering data ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Note data filtered Observed_Date_Time field. types Character. Data types connect . One "this_yr", "yr_2_5", "yr_5_10", "historic", "" (default ""). Ignored dates specified. convert_times Logical. Whether convert character date/times date/time format R. Defaults TRUE. FALSE remain character.

title: Connect to ENMODS data via DuckDB — renmods_connect
text: tbl_duckdb_connection object - lazy DuckDB table. Use dplyr functions filter/select, collect() load R memory.

title: Connect to ENMODS data via DuckDB — renmods_connect
text: Note ENMODS stores date/times character/text fields timezone indicated +/- offset (e.g., '-08:00'). However, R values column must use timezone. Therefore times converted UTC-7:00 (called Etc/GMT+7, note + correct; see Wikipedia page timezones). original timezone Observed_Date_Time stored new field ren_tz reference. can convert timezone using lubridate::with_tz() function.

title: Connect to ENMODS data via DuckDB — renmods_connect
code: if (FALSE) { # interactive() # All data db <- renmods_connect()  # All current data db <- renmods_connect(types = "this_yr")  # Connect only to data types required for a specific date range db <- renmods_connect(dates = c("2025-01-01", "2025-02-01")) db <- renmods_connect(dates = c("1990-01-01", "1990-02-01"))  # Use dplyr to manipulate the data library(dplyr)  # Explore the data and column names colnames(db) glimpse(db)  # Filter and collect specific data df <- db |>   filter(Location_ID %in% c("E327371", "E300230")) |>   select(     "Location_ID", "Location_Name", "Observed_Date_Time",     "Observed_Property_Name", "Result_Value", "Result_Unit",     "Analysis_Method_ID"   ) |>   collect()  # Remember to shut down the connection when you're done renmods_disconnect(db) }
